title: Upstox Refer and Earn Demat with GroMo in 2026
summary: Upstox refer and earn 2026: the official voucher program (today price, 10/month limit, T&Cs) versus the GroMo distribution route with cash commissions, compared honestly.
body_markdown:
Upstox Refer and Earn works two ways in 2026. The official program rewards existing Upstox users with brand vouchers for referring friends, capped at the first 10 successful referrals a month, with the live reward amount shown only inside the app. The second route is GroMo, a separate program where GroMo acts as a distribution partner: you earn cash commission per activated Upstox account, paid to your bank, with no monthly cap and no need to hold an Upstox account yourself.


This guide covers both honestly: today's price and how it is set, the voucher system, the referral limit, the terms that quietly disqualify referrals, and why both routes only pay when you refer genuine people.


## Upstox refer and earn: quick facts


Question Quick answer


Official reward Brand vouchers, exact amount shown in the app's rewards screen


Referral limit First 10 successful referrals per calendar month


Payout timing By the 1st or 16th of the month, whichever is closer


Withdrawal condition You must be an active Upstox user with at least 1 trade in the last 365 days


Friend's deadline Account must be completed within 7 days of OTP sign-up


GroMo route Separate program: cash commission per activated account, campaign rates in the GroMo app


Is it free? Yes, both routes are completely free to join and share


## Way 1: the official Upstox Refer and Earn program


The official program is built for existing Upstox users referring friends and family. Three steps: share your unique link, your friend signs up and opens a demat account through the Upstox app, and you earn vouchers redeemable across multiple brands.


### How to get your Upstox refer and earn link


1. Log in to the Upstox app with your PIN or biometrics.
2. Tap the Upstox icon at the top left and choose Refer and Earn.
3. Share the link through any app, copy it directly, or sync contacts to send WhatsApp invites from the app.


### Upstox refer and earn today price: how the reward is actually set


There is no permanent public rate, and that is the answer most articles get wrong. The reward is whatever offer is active when your friend completes mobile and email OTP verification, and the current amount appears only on the app's rewards screen, which also shows your total earnable for the month. The reward locks to the offer live at your friend's verification time, so a later rate change does not affect a referral already in progress.


**The honest Upstox refer and earn today price calculator:** open the rewards screen, note today's per-referral value, and multiply by your realistic conversions, capped at 10 a month. If today's rate is Rs 200 in vouchers, five completed referrals is Rs 1,000, and the monthly ceiling is Rs 2,000. Swap in the live number, that is the whole calculator, and any site quoting a fixed rate is out of date by design.


### Upstox refer and earn voucher: what you get and when


Rewards come as brand vouchers, not cash, redeemable across multiple partner brands from the rewards section. Credits land by the 1st or the 16th of the month, whichever is closer, shifting to the next working day on holidays. One condition catches people at withdrawal: you must be an active Upstox user with at least one trade in the last 365 days.


### Upstox refer and earn limit and the terms that disqualify referrals


The limit: rewards apply to your first 10 successful referrals per calendar month, and the ceiling itself can change from time to time. Beyond the limit, extra referrals earn nothing that month.


The Upstox refer and earn terms and conditions that actually disqualify referrals:


- Your friend must open the account through the Upstox mobile app via your link, any other channel makes it ineligible.
- Their PAN must never have been used with Upstox before, past leads and old registrations do not count.
- The account must be completed within 7 days of OTP sign-up, after that the link mapping expires.
- Bulk invitations to strangers, social media promotion, selling invitations, and running contests are explicitly prohibited, violations forfeit accrued rewards and can go further.


That last clause matters more than the reward amount: the official program is designed for personal referrals only.


## Way 2: Upstox referrals through GroMo


GroMo is a separate program from Upstox Refer and Earn, and the distinction matters. GroMo is a financial product distribution platform, an official distribution partner channel, where banks and brokers pay cash commissions for customer acquisition. When Upstox campaigns are live in the GroMo catalogue, you earn a cash commission for every activated account, with the current rate shown on the product card in the app.


**What changes versus the official program:**


- **Cash, not vouchers:** commissions credit to your bank account as withdrawable money.
- **No monthly referral cap:** the distribution model is built for volume.
- **No Upstox account needed:** one free GroMo KYC replaces the be-a-customer-first requirement, and there is no trade-in-365-days condition.
- **Multi-broker fallback:** if your contact already has an Upstox account, the new-PAN rule kills the official referral, but on GroMo you simply offer another broker's demat account instead, the full comparison is in[demat account refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/demat-account-refer-and-earn/) .


Availability and rates depend on live partner campaigns, check the GroMo app for the current Upstox card. The same model extends past demat into cards, loans, and[saving account refer and earn](https://gromo.in/blog/saving-account-refer-and-earn/) , which is how agents stack product lines into one income, as the[sell financial products and earn money](https://gromo.in/blog/sell-financial-products-and-earn-money/) playbook shows.


## Refer genuine people, both routes depend on it


Neither route pays for spray-and-pray sharing, and the incentives are built that way on purpose.


On the official program, rewards trigger only after full account activation, and the T&Cs prohibit bulk and social blasting outright. On GroMo, commission comes only when the account activates and verifies, a pile of half-opened accounts earns zero.


The working method is the same for both: refer people who genuinely want to start investing, help them through the 7-day window and the KYC steps, and be honest that a demat account is for investing, not a favour to you. Genuine referrals convert, complete, and refer their own friends onward, which is the only version of this that compounds.


## Prefer cash over vouchers?


*Refer demat accounts, cards, and savings accounts through GroMo and earn cash commission on every activation. Free to join, rates live in the app.*

## FAQ: Upstox refer and earn


**1. How much can I earn on Upstox Refer and Earn in 2026?**
Officially: up to 10 successful referrals a month at the voucher rate shown live in the app, so the ceiling is 10 times today's in-app rate. Through GroMo: cash commission per activated account at the campaign rate in the app, with no monthly cap, so the ceiling is set by how many genuine customers you can serve.


**2. How much do I get for a referral?**
On the official program, the voucher value active at the moment your friend completes OTP verification, check the rewards screen for today's number, no permanent public rate exists. On GroMo, the cash rate on the Upstox product card at the time of the referral.


**3. Which broker gives the highest refer and earn?**
It changes with campaigns: Upstox tiers have historically run up to Rs 1,200 in top campaigns, while Angel One and Groww run their own rotating offers. Brokerage-sharing programs like Dhan pay more over time for active traders. The stable answer is the multi-broker route, offer whichever broker's live campaign pays best, the ranking lives in[high paying refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/high-paying-refer-and-earn-apps/) .


**4. Which app is best for refer and earn?**
For referring one broker to friends, that broker's own app, Upstox's program is clean and its payout dates are predictable. For referring many financial products as an income, GroMo, cash payouts, no caps, and a catalogue beyond demat. The wider list across categories is in[refer and earn apps in India](https://gromo.in/blog/refer-and-earn-apps-in-india/) .


**5. Is Upstox refer and earn free?**
Yes, completely. Sharing the link costs nothing, your friend pays nothing to open the account, and GroMo registration is also free. Anyone charging you to unlock referral earnings is a scam.


**6. Why did my Upstox referral not count?**
The usual four: the account was opened outside the app or without your link, the PAN was already known to Upstox, the 7-day completion window lapsed, or you crossed the 10-per-month limit. Each referral's status shows in the app.


**7. Can I promote my Upstox referral link on social media?**
No. The terms explicitly prohibit advertisement on social platforms, bulk invitations, and selling invitations, and violations can forfeit all accrued rewards. Personal, genuine referrals only. The GroMo distribution route is the appropriate channel for treating referrals as a business.


**8. Are Upstox Refer and Earn and GroMo the same program?**
No. They are separate: the official program is Upstox's own user-referral scheme paying vouchers, while GroMo is a distribution partner platform paying cash commissions under its own terms. Rewards, rules, and payouts differ, check each in its own app.


## Disclaimer


Upstox Refer and Earn rewards, limits, and conditions are set by Upstox, change with campaigns, and the live reward amount is displayed only inside the Upstox app, always verify the current offer on the official Upstox app or website before referring. GroMo commissions are a separate program with separate terms, verify current Upstox campaign availability and rates inside the GroMo app. GroMo and the Upstox referral program are independent of each other, GroMo is a distribution partner platform, and this article is not published or endorsed by Upstox. Referral and commission income depends on successful account activations and can be zero. Investments in securities markets are subject to market risks. This article is for information only and is not financial advice. GroMo is available only to users aged 18 and above.
